history.overview: Scar South is the primary Muramite assault route toward the Dranik Catacombs.

timeline.name: Canyon Collapse
timeline.description: Dragorn miners abandoned the unstable southern cliffs.

timeline.name: Muramite Advance
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the canyon as a forward assault route.

timeline.name: Discord Ruptures
timeline.description: Discord energy tore open the stone, creating rupture fields.

timeline.name: Resistance Last Stand
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels established fallback trenches to slow Muramite advances.
